title: Finance Data Analyst
description:
Your new company
You will be joining an established and successful organisation that is continuing to invest in its finance and data capabilities. As part of this development, the business is looking to appoint an experienced Finance Data Analyst to support the finance function and help turn complex data into meaningful commercial insight.

Your new role
As Finance Data Analyst, you will play a key role in transforming financial and operational data into clear reporting, dashboards and actionable insights. Working closely with stakeholders across finance and the wider business, you will help improve visibility of performance and support more informed strategic decision-making. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Developing and maintaining interactive Power BI dashboards and reports
  • Building data models and using DAX to provide meaningful analysis
  • Extracting, understanding and analysing financial and business data from SAP
  • Using advanced Excel, including PivotTables, formulas and Power Query
  • Querying and joining datasets using SQL
  • Cleaning, transforming and combining data using Power Query
  • Identifying opportunities to improve and automate existing reporting processes using Power Automate
  • Translating complex datasets into clear commercial insights for senior stakeholders
  • Supporting the finance team with analysis to improve business performance and decision-making



What you'll need to succeed
You will be an experienced Business Data Analyst, Finance Data Analyst or commercially focused BI/Data Analyst with strong technical and stakeholder-facing skills. You will ideally demonstrate:

  • Strong Power BI capability, including dashboards, data modelling and DAX
  • Experience working with SAP and financial/business datasets
  • Advanced Excel skills
  • Good working knowledge of SQL
  • Strong experience with Power Query
  • Exposure to Power Automate would be highly advantageous
  • The ability to translate complex data into meaningful business insight
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • A bachelor's degree



What you'll get in return
You will receive a competitive salary of £50,000-£60,000 on a hybrid working pattern, alongside the opportunity to join an established organisation in a highly visible role within its finance function. This is an excellent opportunity for somebody who enjoys combining data analytics, finance and technology to directly influence business performance.

What you need to do now
If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now. If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.
